question: What are the class timings for CSL3050?
sources: AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Classroom Allocation); AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Examination); AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Slot System)
answer:
The class timings for CSL3050 are as follows:

- Monday: 9:00 AM - 9:50 AM
- Tuesday: 9:00 AM - 9:50 AM
- Thursday: 9:00 AM - 9:50 AM

Minor Exam Date: 19 September 2026, Saturday, 08:00 AM to 10:00 AM (tentative)

Institute attendance policy: attendance in every course must not fall below 75%; a student below 75% without a valid reason can be de-registered from the course and then cannot sit its examinations (Source: AY 2026-27_Semester I_Circular_51Circular-No.-IITJOAACircular2024-2551682-dated-08-July-2024.pdf, page 1).
